summary: Enhance your financial expertise with our Taxation Fundamentals course. Learn essential tax principles and strategies tailored for finance professionals.
lede: Taxation fundamentals help finance professionals connect financial reporting with tax calculations and compliance. Designed for finance practitioners responsible for tax reporting, the course covers reconciling accounting profit with taxable income, accounting for current and deferred taxes, and assessing indirect tax processes such as VAT/GST recovery. It also develops skills in tax risk registers, transfer pricing documentation, compliance workflows, and communicating tax positions to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for finance practitioners who need to integrate tax technical knowledge into their daily operational and strategic workflows.
audience: Indirect Tax Specialists focused on VAT/GST recovery
modules: Corporate Income Tax and Global Landscape
Accounting for Income Taxes under IAS 12
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial accounting principles and experience working with corporate financial statements. No prior specialized tax knowledge is required, though familiarity with IFRS or local GAAP is highly recommended.
